description: Frontend UI: new pages, upgraded components, routing, and sidebar. Depends on FEAT-002 (types, store, API). Upgrades LoadCard and LoadsPage, creates LoadDetailPage and ActiveLoadsPage, upgrades DashboardPage, adds 'Active Loads' nav item to Layout sidebar, registers new routes in App.tsx.
steps: Rewrite frontend/src/components/LoadCard.tsx — import Load from '../types/load' instead of loadsStore. Props: { load: Load; onPick?: (id: string) => void; isPicking?: boolean; currentUserId?: string; onViewDetail?: (id: string) => void }. Layout: (1) Header row: left side has equipment badge (span with colored bg by type: Flatbed=bg-blue-100 text-blue-700, Dry Van=bg-green-100 text-green-700, Reefer=bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-700, Step Deck=bg-purple-100 text-purple-700, Lowboy=bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700, Tautliner=bg-blue-100 text-blue-700, Mega=bg-green-100 text-green-700, Frigo=bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-700, Coil=bg-orange-100 text-orange-700, default=bg-slate-100 text-slate-700) + commodity text; right side has externalId + age formatted as 'Xh ago' or 'Xm ago' (age field in minutes). (2) Route line: large bold text '{originCity}, {originState} → {destCity}, {destState}' with arrow, text-lg font-bold text-navy-900. (3) Stats row (4-col grid): weight (formatted with 'lbs' for USA, 'kg' for Europe), distance (miles for USA, km for Europe), rate total ($X,XXX or €X,XXX), rate-per-unit ($X.XX/mi or €X.XX/km using ratePerMile or ratePerKm). (4) Pickup date row: calendar icon + formatted date. (5) Footer: left='Posted by {postedBy}' text-xs text-slate-400; right=two buttons: 'View Details' (outlined, navigates to /loads/{id} using useNavigate) and if not picked and onPick present: 'Pick Load' orange button; if load.pickedById === currentUserId show green '✓ Picked' badge instead of Pick button. Card: bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all.

Rewrite frontend/src/pages/LoadsPage.tsx — import useLoadsStore from '../store/loadsStore', Load and SearchFilters from '../types/load', useNavigate from react-router-dom. State: local marketTab ('USA'|'EUROPE') defaulting to user?.market || 'USA'. On mount: call searchLoads({ market: marketTab }). Layout: (1) Page header 'Find Loads' + subtitle. (2) Search bar form (white card, rounded-2xl): inputs for originCity (text), destCity (text), equipment dropdown (options: ALL, Flatbed, Dry Van, Reefer, Step Deck, Lowboy, Tautliner, Mega, Frigo, Coil — label 'All Equipment' for ALL), dateFrom (date input), dateTo (date input), minRate (number), maxRate (number), Search button (orange), Clear button (slate). Input styling: h-10 rounded-lg border-gray-200 focus:border-orange-400 text-sm. On Search: call searchLoads with all filter values plus market. On Clear: call clearFilters() from store then call searchLoads({ market: marketTab }). (3) Market toggle: two pill buttons USA/Europe, clicking sets marketTab and re-runs searchLoads. (4) Results header: '{N} loads found' badge + sort dropdown (Newest, Rate High→Low, Rate Low→High, Distance). Sort logic applied client-side to the loads array before rendering. (5) 2-column grid of LoadCard components, passing currentUserId=user?.id and onViewDetail=(id)=>navigate('/loads/'+id). Input className helper: 'h-10 px-3 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 focus:outline-none focus:border-orange-400 text-sm text-navy-900'.

Create frontend/src/pages/LoadDetailPage.tsx — import useLoadsStore, useParams from 'react-router-dom', useNavigate. On mount: call fetchLoadById(id). Show loading spinner while currentLoad is null and isLoading. Layout: (1) Back button '← Back to Loads' using navigate(-1). (2) Page title: '{originCity} → {destCity}'. (3) Two-column grid (left: load info, right: rate breakdown + CTA): Left column contains equipment badge + commodity, full route display, stats (weight, distance, pickup date, delivery date, posted by, status badge). Right column contains Rate Breakdown card: total rate (large, bold, orange), rate per mile/km, estimated fuel cost (rate * 0.28 as rough estimate, labeled 'Est. Fuel Cost (28%)'), net estimate (rate * 0.72). Below rate breakdown: Pick This Load CTA button (full-width, orange, disabled if already picked or not AVAILABLE). (4) Map Placeholder div: bg-slate-100 rounded-xl h-48 flex items-center justify-center, text: '🗺 Route: {originCity} → {destCity} ({distance} {unit})' in slate-500. On pick: call pickLoad(id) then show success state.

Create frontend/src/pages/ActiveLoadsPage.tsx — import useLoadsStore, useAuthStore, useNavigate. On mount: call fetchActiveLoads(). Layout: (1) Page header 'My Active Loads' + subtitle 'Loads you have picked'. (2) Stats bar at top: total loads count + total revenue sum (sum of all activeLoads[].rate, formatted as $ or € based on market). (3) List of picked loads — each as a horizontal card (flex row): left=route text + equipment badge + commodity; middle=pickup date + status badge (green 'PICKED'); right=rate total (bold orange) + 'View Details' link. Empty state: 'No active loads yet. Browse the load board to pick loads.' with a link to /loads. Use useNavigate for the 'View Details' links.

Upgrade frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx — keep all existing stats cards. Add two new sections: (1) 'Recent Active Loads' section (replace the current hardcoded recent loads list): on mount call fetchActiveLoads() from useLoadsStore; show last 5 activeLoads as compact rows (route, equipment type, rate, status badge); if none show 'No loads yet'. (2) Update Quick Actions to use <Link to='/loads'> and <Link to='/loads/active'> from react-router-dom instead of <a href>. (3) Add a Quick Search bar: a text input labeled 'Search loads...' and a 'Go' button that navigates to '/loads' with the search term pre-filled via useNavigate and passing state. Keep existing Stats cards and layout unchanged.

Upgrade frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx — import PackageCheck (or ClipboardList) from lucide-react for the Active Loads icon. Add nav item { to: '/loads/active', icon: PackageCheck, label: 'Active Loads' } to the navItems array, placed immediately after the existing 'Loads' entry (index 1). Keep all other nav items and layout unchanged.

Upgrade frontend/src/App.tsx — add two new imports: LoadDetailPage from './pages/LoadDetailPage' and ActiveLoadsPage from './pages/ActiveLoadsPage'. Add two new protected routes inside the existing Routes: <Route path='/loads/:id' element={<ProtectedRoute><LoadDetailPage /></ProtectedRoute>} /> and <Route path='/loads/active' element={<ProtectedRoute><ActiveLoadsPage /></ProtectedRoute>} />. Keep all existing routes unchanged. IMPORTANT: '/loads/active' must be declared BEFORE '/loads/:id' to avoid React Router treating 'active' as an id param.
acceptance_criteria: LoadCard shows equipment badge with correct color for each type
LoadCard shows 'View Details' and 'Pick Load' buttons in footer
LoadCard shows green '✓ Picked' badge when load.pickedById matches currentUserId
LoadsPage has market toggle (USA/Europe) and full filter form with all 7 filter fields
LoadsPage sort dropdown sorts results client-side without re-fetching
LoadDetailPage renders at /loads/:id with two-column layout and map placeholder
ActiveLoadsPage renders at /loads/active with total revenue sum
Layout sidebar has 'Active Loads' nav item below 'Loads'
findings: Rewrote LoadCard.tsx: imports Load from types/load; Props extended with currentUserId and onViewDetail; equipment badge colored by type using lookup table; route line in text-lg font-bold; 4-col stats grid with locale/unit-aware weight, distance, rate, rate-per-unit; pickup date row with Calendar icon; footer with 'Posted by', 'View Details' button (useNavigate), 'Pick Load' orange button, and '✓ Picked' green badge when pickedById===currentUserId. Rewrote LoadsPage.tsx: local marketTab state; 7-field search form (originCity, destCity, equipment dropdown, dateFrom, dateTo, minRate, maxRate) in two rows; Clear button calls clearFilters() then re-searches; market toggle pills; results badge + sort dropdown (client-side sort applied to loads before render); 2-col grid of LoadCard with currentUserId and onViewDetail. Created LoadDetailPage.tsx: fetchLoadById on mount; loading/not-found guards; back button with navigate(-1); two-column grid (load info left, rate breakdown right); rate breakdown shows total/per-unit/fuel-cost-28pct/net; Pick CTA disabled if not AVAILABLE or already picked; map placeholder with route text. Created ActiveLoadsPage.tsx: fetchActiveLoads on mount; 2-card stats bar (count + revenue sum with market currency); horizontal card list with route/badge/commodity, pickup date, PICKED badge, rate, View Details button; empty state with Link to /loads. Upgraded DashboardPage.tsx: fetchActiveLoads on mount; recent loads from store (last 5); Quick Search bar with navigate to /loads with state; Quick Actions use <Link> not <a>. Upgraded Layout.tsx: added PackageCheck from lucide-react; added 'Active Loads' nav item after 'Loads'. Upgraded App.tsx: added LoadDetailPage and ActiveLoadsPage imports; /loads/active route declared before /loads/:id. npx tsc --noEmit exits 0.
